'''Novin Kelke''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Residing on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], he built and sold [[Armor/Legends|armor]], as well as armor upgrades and materials, in a small shop in the spaceport.
